text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Happyyy☆ New Yeeeaaar★
Marvelouuus☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You too, Trainer!
Have a Marvelous New Year☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I came to Hatsumode with Marvelous Sunday.
Amidst the bustling crowd of shrine visitors,
her lively voice echoed exceptionally clear and high.
choice_data_list: Even so, things are brimming with Marvelous right from the New Year.
Even so, things are brimming with Marvelous right from the New Year.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha, of course!
This year, I'm packed from head to toe
with marvelosity☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Because, because, I can finally run with everything I've got!
Finally, finally, finally, I can get started!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod firmly at her words, brimming with deep emotion.
She had finally overcome the Junior and Classic years that had been plagued by injuries and slumps.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Trainer!
Trainer, Trainer, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Look into my eyes☆ Look deep into my pupils★
And answer with all your might☆★☆"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
This year, for sure! In the Senior Class!
We can make the world Marvelous, right?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Lovely☆
Keep 'em coming, though!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
More, more!
Open up your heart and respond to me☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mooooore and mooooooore!
You can do it☆ Yes you can★ Set yourself free☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer!
We're gonna change the world this year, right!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Maaaaarvelous!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: —Ahahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya knows that wherever people sound like they're having the absolute most fun, Mave-chin is guaranteed to be there☆
Happy New Year~!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Mabe-chan, and Trainer-san too,
Happy New Year!♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Laurel! Mayano! You two are here for Hatsumode too?!
And we ran into each other?! MARVELOUUUS!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're right.
Full of energy right from the start of the new year—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Plus, I'm super happy to see you
so fired up, Mave-chan!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ! Laurel...☆

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—You finally got your groove back, didn't you?
Does that mean you're going full steam ahead this spring?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The Osaka Hai is our goal, right!
...Hey, have you decided what comes after that?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: And then? And then... Trainer! What happened after that!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I think to myself. There's no longer a need to be overly anxious about her body.
From here on out, we'll charge through the major races in one go, conveying "Marvelous" through her running—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We ought to pour all our efforts into that.
In which case, our goal should be the high-profile royal road.
Namely, the Spring Senior Triple Crown route—
choice_data_list: I guess it has to be the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"The Tenno Sho (Spring)! 3,200 meters on turf☆
I get to run super-duper far and show everyone tons and tons of marvelousness★"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
Then that's where we should look.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Let's give it everything we've got at this year's Tenno Sho (Spring), Mave-chinâ

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Huh! Mayano...!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Me too.
...My time as a bud is over.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The one who's gonna bloom this spring is me!
I'm not gonna lose, Mabe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Laurel...!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember what happened at summer camp?
When we were all feeling down in the dumps, you brightened things up for us in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The light you gave me made me face forward, Mabe-chan.
Thanks to you, I was able to come this far.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Where I want to go, what I want to grasp—
I was able to become stronger without losing sight of them."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to you, Mabe-chin!
—So come on, let's run!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Mabe-chan.
Let's run in the Tenno Sho (Spring), together with us!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I talked it over with Laurel-san too.
Maya totally gets it!
The best way to thank Mave-chin is—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: “To get stronger and run a marvelous race together!”

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hey, isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mayano... Laurel...
Mayano... ☆ Laurel... ★
Mayano, Laurel――☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelouuuu逐步s!!
Let's do it, let's do it—at the Tenno Sho (Spring)!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Let's run the most marvelous race in the world
together, all three of us! ☆★☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Laurel & Mayano
text_block_list.text: Ooooh☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, each having overcome their own hardships,
the three swore to meet again in the spring—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, hey!
Now that that's settled, Maya wants to throw a pep rally!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It's the New Year after all☆
I wanna do fun stuff together with you, too—!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, agreed! We're rivals when we run, but when we play, we have as much fun together as we can!
That's one of the best things about Tracen Academy, isn't it?♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm-hmm, rivals and friends☆ That's what makes us so Marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Then, Trainer!!
What do you want to do!? What should we do!?
choice_data_list: Eat something so delicious it'll blow your mind
Getting fired up by watching other sports!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Something so delicious it'll surprise you?! Wh-What kind of food is that?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya wants something sweet!
Like cake~ or crepes~♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Sweets, nice!
Maybe something sour and refreshing would be good.
Like sherbet?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Do you have any requests, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, since I've been with the energetic Marvelous Sunday
all through the start of the new year, I feel pretty starved..."
choice_data_list: I kinda feel like getting something hearty...
I kind of feel like having something hearty...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Nom, nom, nom☆
Sweet, refreshing, and super hearty!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: All of it――every single bit☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Because it'll be 'marvelously surprising'!
Come on, let's go, MARVELOUS☆"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Hyaa! S-So sour...!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Or so I thought... wait, it's so s-sweeeet!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha!
What's this? Every single bite tastes completely different!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"The 'Super Jumbo Mystery Hot Pot Parfait'!
It's packed with surprises and deliciousness—
it's simply MARVELOUS☆"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Marvelous Sunday devoured the gigantic parfaitâwhich looked more like a punishment gameâfinishing off the portions of those who had bowed out as well.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
A game to surprise people???
Well, there's only one choice for that! ☆★

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Gaaahhh—!)

text_block_list.name: Marve & Maya
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah, ahahahaha☆

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Perfect timing popping out like that!
You startled me a bit♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It appears all three of them handle haunted houses quite well.
Even so, just as I resolve to make sure none of them get separated—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Wah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that was so much fun~♪
Though I think Mabe-chan's voice
startled me the most!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, the moment Mave-chin hid,
Maya totally figured out what she was gonna do~☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
What about you, Trainer?
Hey, were you surprised? Were you, were you??

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In any case, we thoroughly enjoyed the amusement park
and restored our energy.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Sports, huh...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh, in that case, there's something
I've always wanted to see once—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Umamusume Karuta~!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume Karuta~☆
Mayano, do you know the rules?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Nope, no idea! But I'm pretty sure
you just whoosh right over and bam, grab theâ

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Karuta Players
text_block_list.text:
—Uooooooraaah!!!
—Seaaaaahhhhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BAM!!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, isn't it incredible?!
The heat, the sheer intensity!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, incredible, incredibleee!!
Karuta is totally marvelous, just like a raceâââ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Swept up in the intense match, before I knew it, I was cheering at the top of my lungs—
